title: EV charging in Portugal | VOOL
description: VOOL chargers and load management in Portugal: local partners, grants and rules, and datasheets.

sections.title: EV charging for buildings in Portugal, on the connection they already have
sections.lead: Chargers, load management and billing from one maker. Sold and installed by 4 partners in Portugal.

sections.title: Grants and rules in Portugal
paragraphs: The Fundo Ambiental supports chargers in multi-family condominiums.
points: The incentive is 80% of the charger price, up to €800, plus 80% of the installation, up to €1,000, per parking space.
Up to 10 chargers per condominium, one per resident.
The 2026 round was fully taken on the day it opened, 11 June 2026. Prepare the quote and documents before the next round opens.

items.title: Apartment buildings
items.text: Many chargers on the existing main fuse, with each resident paying for their own charging.

items.title: Offices and fleets
items.text: Employees pay for private charging; company cars are reported separately.

items.title: Developers
items.text: Design charging into new buildings and size the connection smaller.

items.title: Sell or install VOOL in Portugal
items.text: We are adding partners in this market.

items.a: No. Local partners sell and install. VOOL makes the hardware and software and supports the partners.
From 1 January 2027 newly installed chargers in the EU must support ISO 15118-20. The new VOOL Charger does.

sections.title: Planning charging in Portugal?
sections.lead: Send us the parking spaces and the main fuse size. We reply within one working day.
